  js=`let b=document.getElementById('liquid'),info=document.getElementById('glassStatus');b.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(reduced)return;const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();b.style.setProperty('--x',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100)+'%');b.style.setProperty('--y',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100)+'%');b.querySelector('i').style.transform='rotate('+((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5)*${depth*.7}+'deg)'});b.addEventListener('click',()=>{info.textContent='Light refracted · Interaction captured';b.animate([{filter:'brightness(1)'},{filter:'brightness(1.8)'},{filter:'brightness(1)'}],{duration:${Math.round(700/speed)}})});`;
 }else if(item.id==='aurora-flow'){

 }else if(item.id==='cursor-light'){

 }else if(item.id==='cinematic-reveal'){
  inner=`<div class="film"><section class="filmScene"><div class="filmVisual"><div class="bigSphere"></div></div><div class="filmCopy"><p class="eyebrow">16 / CINEMATIC REVEAL</p><h1>${text}</h1><p class="muted">Scroll to uncover the next scene</p></div></section><section class="filmScene two"><div class="filmVisual"><div class="bigSphere"></div></div><div class="filmCopy"><p class="eyebrow">THE NEXT FRAME</p><h1>BEYOND THE FRAME</h1></div></section></div><style>.filmScene{position:relative;min-height:100vh;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center}.filmVisual{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 65% 35%,#64788b,#141b27 55%,#06080d);transform:scale(1.22);transition:transform calc(1.9s/var(--speed)) cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);filter:saturate(.9)}.filmScene.seen .filmVisual{transform:scale(1)}.bigSphere{position:absolute;left:55%;top:18%;width:min(50vw,430px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,#ffffff, var(--accent) 28%,#192e4b 64%,#050a10);box-shadow:0 0 100px #000b}.filmCopy{position:relative;text-align:center;max-width:90vw;opacity:0;transform:translateY(80px);transition:opacity 1s,transform 1s}.seen .filmCopy{opacity:1;transform:none}.two .filmVisual{background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 70%,#5b3b52,#101020 60%,#050814)}.two .bigSphere{left:5%;top:24%;width:min(42vw,350px)}</style>`;

 }else if(item.id==='glass-dashboard'){
